items.description: Replay and visualize Git history as a timeline of commits, branches, and merges.
AI Agent skill that visualizes any Java Controller endpoint as a structured Markdown document — data flow, DB operations, branch logic, at a glance.

An ML-driven computer architecture project that replaces legacy 2-bit branch predictors with an XGBoost ensemble. Uses Intel Pin for trace extraction, m2cgen for bare-metal C++ transpilation, and features a Dockerized Streamlit visualization dashboard.
A mod for Claude Code that integrates Git Graph visualization, helping developers easily trace commit history and branch structures directly within the CLI environment.
Status lights for AI agents: branch-tree replay and drift scoring for any agent trace (Claude Code, OpenTelemetry GenAI).

CPU Pipeline Simulator with UI A C++ based CPU pipeline simulator supporting operand forwarding and branch predictors. Includes a modern React/Tailwind UI to visualize timelines, stalls, hazards, CPI, and compare runs with example traces in traces/.
